headline: Demant Shares Face Investor Test Following 70% Year-to-Date Surge
summary: Danish hearing aid manufacturer Demant faces investor scrutiny over whether its operational growth momentum can sustain its 70% share price rally this year.
why: Demant is a major constituent of Denmark's OMX Copenhagen 25 index; profit-taking by institutional holders impacts Danish equity market performance.

impacts.name: Demant
impacts.why: Profit-taking after a 70% stock gain pressured the equity price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors chose to lock in gains following a major multi-month share price expansion.
